48.original: Well met, adventurer. My name's Galiena, and I work at the House of Splendors for my aunt Rowena.

49.original: Following her successful expansion into Idyllshire and the three city<hex:021F0103>states, she's decided to bring her operations here to Rhalgr's Reach.

50.original: Our presence here serves to aid the recovery effort, creating jobs for refugees and stimulating the economy. With your skills, you would be of great help to us.

51.original: And of course, if you have any collectables, I'd be happy to take them off your hands in exchange for scrips. With locations realm-wide, it has never been easier to do business with the House of Splendors!

52.original: Well met, adventurer. If you know any able crafters or gatherers, I'd be thankful for an introduction.

53.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 60 or above.
